verdict.rationale: Dropbox's Dash product is documented as giving AI answers and document insights from the user's files, and as helping summarize, review and organize files with AI. However, the evidence is mostly resource-article headlines, and the main dropbox.com page says AI 'is coming', which leaves availability and depth unclear. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on how insights and suggestions are generated inside core Dropbox (not only Dash), explicit evidence of proactive suggestions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI answers for busy teams: Get document insights without the digging
Dash helps you search for shared team knowledge across all your apps to get clear answers and move projects forward, faster.
How to organize files with AI and find what matters faster
AI is coming to Dropbox, with smarter search, faster drafting and summarization, and intelligent organization.
